rounds.sentence: THE VOLCANO GOES UP AND THEN DOWN

title: Copy the word
offscreen: A lined exercise book: every day a word from the story you read, written three times in joined-up writing.

intro.bo: {nome}, here we write whole words. I mix up my letters, but you don't.
intro.pilu: Long words, {nome}: one letter at a time, and the sound tells you which one.
intro.tango: {nome}, grown-up words! Come on, one letter at a time.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. If you like, you can do this one with real things too.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}. The same thing exists with real objects: ask a grown-up.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, shall we do it with real things tomorrow? I'll bring my paws.
